title: Piano and the Sheep
description: A surreal night scene inside a dark, dilapidated room where a person’s left hand plays an old upright piano. Through a broken window, several sheep with glowing eyes stand in a swampy pond surrounded by reeds and lily pads under a starry night sky. Crumpled sheet music, a fallen mug, and spiderwebs are scattered across the dusty wooden floor.
prompt: A surreal dark painting of an old upright piano being played by a single visible hand in a decaying room at night. Through a shattered window, several realistic sheep with glowing eyes stand in a swampy pond with reeds and lily pads. Crumpled sheet music and spiderwebs cover the dusty floor, eerie moonlight illuminates the scene, mysterious and unsettling atmosphere, painted in a realistic yet dreamlike style
